description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Client Charges API in the Fineract project. It contains nested classes representing request and response schemas, including details about charges, currencies, and associated metadata.

classes.name: ClientChargesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes that define the schemas for client charges API request and response payloads, primarily used for API documentation and serialization.

classes.name: GetClientsClientIdChargesResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving client charges response, including total records and page items metadata.

classes.name: GetClientsChargesPageItems
classes.description: Represents individual charge item details in the paginated response.

classes.name: GetClientChargeTimeType
classes.description: Schema for the charge time type enumeration, including id, code, and description.

classes.name: GetClientChargeCalculationType
classes.description: Schema for the charge calculation type enumeration, including id, code, and description.

classes.name: GetClientChargeCurrency
classes.description: Schema for currency details associated with a charge.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdChargesRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new client charge request payload.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdChargesResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a new client charge.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdChargesChargeIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for adding a charge to a client by charge ID.

classes.name: PostClientsClientIdChargesChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after adding a charge by charge ID.

classes.name: DeleteClientsClientIdChargesChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after deleting a client charge.
